seed.deterministic_debug_cohort: Earlier BIR L40S fixed-seed42 runs retained separately; not independent quality replicates.
seed.limitation: Deployed HTTP schema rejects seed. Current is uncontrolled; persistent/BIR use matched candidate seed sequence. No bit-identical or same-random-draw claim.

msa: All supplied ordinary A3M rows retained, no remote MSA request and no query-only substitution.
templates: Deployed API does not accept templates. None passed to any comparator.

complex_fixture.paired_msa_and_templates: Not representable by deployed API; absent from all variants, explicitly distinct from complete upstream 7sfy JSON.

client: stdlib urllib in the same pod via loopback HTTP; quality validation on client CPU
clock: time.monotonic accepted client POST to response bytes, separately through semantic validation; excludes no failed attempts
baseline_model_residency: Every request launches a new boltz predict subprocess with --no_kernels. HTTP ready only confirms CUDA and cached artifacts.
candidate_residency: Single uvicorn process holds actual model. Persistent upstream uses original data pipeline, predict_step, and writer, bypassing Lightning teardown. BIR uses public wheel plus diffusion CUDA graph.
quality: Sequence-aligned CA-lDDT to experimental reference, 15 angstrom reference-neighbor cutoff and 0.5/1/2/4 angstrom thresholds; all coordinates finite and expected residue count. Not OpenStructure all-atom lDDT or biological efficacy.
